backend/main.mo: Main backend actor that integrates blob storage, access control, and Stripe payment functionality with admin-only configuration and user checkout session creation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features related to diagnosing blank white screen issues and ensuring proper router configuration in App.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including routing, dashboard pages, components, hooks, and utilities for the Propfolio trading management application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme color schemes including sidebar, chart, and UI component colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React application from main.tsx into a root div element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component defining TanStack Router configuration with routes for landing page, dashboard pages, admin panel, legal pages, and payment flows, wrapped in ThemeProvider with Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AddAccountDialog: Dialog component for adding prop firm accounts with dropdown selection of firms, custom firm input option, and fields for account number and size with validation.
Dashboard layout wrapper that enforces authentication, shows login prompt for unauthenticated users, displays profile setup modal for new users, and renders sidebar with content outlet.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying Propfolio branding, legal links (Privacy/Refund Policy), quick links (Subscribe/Affiliate), and caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A button component that toggles between login and logout states using Internet Identity, with loading states and error handling for re-authentication.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog for new users to complete their profile with required fields (username, full name, email, mobile, Discord ID) that cannot be dismissed until submitted.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Navigation sidebar component displaying the Propfolio logo, menu items for all dashboard sections (with some marked as coming soon), and a login button at the bottom.
frontend/src/constants/propFirms.ts: Exports a sorted array of 60+ proprietary trading firm names like FTMO, Apex Trader Funding, and FundedNext.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook to fetch the current user's profile data; currently returns null to trigger profile setup flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and delegation validity with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook to save user profile data to the backend and update the local cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminAffiliateW: Admin page for managing affiliate withdrawal requests with placeholder content indicating functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDisputes.t: Admin page for viewing and managing user disputes with placeholder content indicating functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOffers.tsx: Admin page for managing discount offers with placeholder content indicating functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Main admin dashboard displaying a grid of 8 clickable cards linking to different admin sections (prop firms, offers, reviews, disputes, products, users, subscriptions, affiliate withdrawals).
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin page for managing shop products and trading tools with placeholder content indicating functionality is coming soon.
Admin page for managing the list of prop firms with placeholder content indicating functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminReviews.ts: Admin page for moderating user reviews with placeholder content indicating functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSubscripti: Admin page for viewing and managing all user subscriptions with a placeholder message indicating functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin page for viewing and managing all user accounts with a placeholder message indicating functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Accounts.ts: Dashboard page for managing prop firm accounts with an add account dialog and empty state prompting users to add their first account.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Affiliate.t: Affiliate program page displaying earnings metrics (total, pending, redeemable) and a referral link with copy functionality for 15% commission on referrals.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Compounding: Capital growth simulator page with a placeholder for a compounding calculator to project trading account growth.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardOv: Main dashboard overview displaying financial metrics (payouts, profit, expenses, tax), payout history, and advance tax reminders with trend indicators.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DiscountOff: Page displaying exclusive prop firm promotional discount offers with an empty state indicating no offers are currently available.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Exchange.ts: Currency exchange page with tabs for FX and crypto converters, both showing placeholder messages for upcoming functionality.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Expenses.ts: Expense tracking page showing business and personal expense totals with an add expense button and empty state for recent expenses.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Giveaways.t: Giveaways page with a coming soon message for exclusive prop firm account giveaways and community promotions.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/IncomeTaxCa: Income tax calculator page with quarterly reminders feature, currently showing a placeholder for upcoming functionality.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/P2PExchange: Peer-to-peer crypto exchange page with a coming soon message for direct cryptocurrency trading between users.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Payouts.tsx: Payout tracking page for recording and viewing prop firm payouts with an add payout button and empty state.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/ReviewsDisp: Page with tabs for writing prop firm reviews and raising disputes, both showing empty states with add buttons.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Settings.ts: User settings page for managing profile and preferences with a placeholder for upcoming functionality.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/TaxAuditRep: Tax audit report generator page with PDF export functionality and placeholder for tax summary configuration.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Tools.tsx: Trading tools page with tabs for five calculators (risk, margin, P/L, lot size, swap), all showing placeholders for upcoming functionality.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/TradingOver: React component displaying a trading analytics dashboard with placeholder metrics (Total Trades, Win Rate, Profit Factor, Sharpe Ratio) and an equity curve chart section, plus an 'Add Trade' button.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/TradingTool: React component for a trading tools shop page that currently displays a placeholder card indicating no products are available yet.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page component displaying hero section, feature grid (12 features like dashboard, payouts, tax reports, trading tools), and call-to-action buttons for signup/login. Includes Footer component and uses Lucide icons.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page displaying an error card with XCircle icon and buttons to retry payment or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page displaying a confirmation card with CheckCircle icon and button to navigate to dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Privacy policy page displaying legal content in a card layout covering information collection, usage, sharing, security, user rights, and contact information.
frontend/src/pages/RefundPolicy.tsx: Refund policy page displaying terms for 30-day money-back guarantee, eligibility, request process, processing time, and non-refundable items.
frontend/src/pages/Subscribe.tsx: Subscription page displaying a single pricing plan card at $75/year with 12 listed features and a subscribe button.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to extract, persist, and manage URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended theme properties (border radius, shadows, animations), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata file documenting Propfolio's architecture, implemented features, known platform limitations (email verification, 2FA, crypto payments), and technical decisions for the prop trading firm management platform.
